The Artist throught Exhibition, Alfred Stieglitz Presents, Seven Americans. March 9-March 28, 1925; Purchase, Doris Huestis Mills Speirs; By descent,  her husband, Dr. J. Murray Speirs; Gift to Art Gallery of Ontario, 1990 
(Source: Art Gallery of Ontario, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Miss O'Keeffe thinks this was sold to Mrs. W. Gordon Mills (Doris Eustice Mills)." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Note: Letter to Mrs. Mills returned –– address unknown." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Donated in memory of Doris Huestis Speirs by her husband, Dr. J. Murray Speirs, 1990. Art Gallery of Ontario
description: A dark purple eggplant with a twisting green stem sits on a surface covered with draped white fabric. The fabric runs the length of the narrow, portrait-oriented composition.
title: Eggplant
